Fellow.ai is hiring recent graduates to join our Engineering team as full-time contributors. You'll own real features from concept to production, collaborating with Product and Design, and using AI tools like Cursor and Claude to accelerate delivery.

About the Role

Our client is actively seeking talented and motivated Graduate Software Engineers for a fully remote position, based out of Kimberley . This is a unique opportunity for recent graduates to launch their careers in software development within a company that embraces remote work culture. You will join a collaborative engineering team, contributing to the design, development, and deployment of innovative software solutions. We provide a supportive environment with ample opportunities for learning and growth, focusing on building scalable and high-quality applications that address real-world problems. This role requires self-discipline and a proactive attitude, essential for success in a remote setting.

• Develop, test, and deploy high-quality software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks.

• Participate actively in code reviews , providing constructive feedback to peers.
• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software systems.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and practices.

Requirements
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

The ideal candidate will have experience in application development, microservices, secure coding, automated testing, and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with QA responsibilities and the ability to perform development and testing activities are highly desirable.
